title: King Asa began his reign by tearing down idols and leading the nation back to God.
paragraphs: King Asa began his reign by tearing down idols and leading the nation back to God.

But later…
when pressure came, he trusted alliances instead of the Lord.
The ending didn’t match the beginning.

Starting strong isn’t the whole story.
Finishing faithful is.
What matters more: how you start or how you finish?

He removed idols.
He led revival.
But later… he stopped trusting God.
A good beginning doesn’t guarantee a good ending.
Stay faithful longer than the applause lasts.
A lot of people start strong.

New faith.
New habits.
New convictions.
But time, pressure, and success test things differently.

Faith isn’t proven at the start.
It’s proven over time.
The people who finish well are the ones who keep trusting God when it gets complicated.
“Why do you think people who start strong sometimes drift later?”
